inputs.lyrics:
[verse]
Walking through the city lights tonight
Every corner tells a different story
Neon signs reflected in the rain
I keep moving though I don't know why

[chorus]
We are the ones who never sleep
Chasing dreams across the streets
Holding on to every breath
Living fast before we rest

[verse]
Memories scattered in the wind
Like pages of an open book
I close my eyes and start again
With every road another look

[chorus]
We are the ones who never sleep
Chasing dreams across the streets
Holding on to every breath
Living fast before we rest
